measures.title: Charter Review Advisory Board Recommendations to Amend Charter - Terms and Qualifications of Commissioners; Election Dates
measures.summary: Changes the Mayor's term from 2 to 4 years and clarifies the qualifications to be Mayor or Commissioner. Moves city elections to the state and federal primary and general election dates, moving the next city election from 2027 to 2028, and provides that competitive races put two candidates on the November ballot.
measures.yesMeans: The city charter is amended to lengthen the Mayor's term to 4 years and move city elections to the state and federal election dates.
measures.noMeans: The Mayor's term and city election dates stay as they are.

measures.title: Charter Review Advisory Board Recommendations to Amend Charter - Charter Officers
measures.summary: Changes the office of City Clerk-Collector to City Comptroller, moves City Clerk duties to the City Manager and treasurer duties to the City Comptroller, and eliminates a public hearing for removal of the City Manager. Requires the City Comptroller, City Attorney and City Manager to be electors in the city and provides for the City Manager to appoint a lead administrator of police and fire services.
measures.yesMeans: The city charter is amended to make these changes to the city's charter officers.
measures.noMeans: The city's charter officer provisions stay as they are.

measures.title: Charter Review Advisory Board Recommendations to Amend Charter - Clerical Revisions; Require 10-year Charter Review
measures.summary: Removes charter articles or sections superseded by state or federal law, such as police, fire, finance, taxation, bonds, public utilities, streets and purchasing, and adds compliance with anti-discrimination laws. Extends the time to fill commission vacancies, provides for acting charter officers and procedural rules, makes clarifying wording changes, and requires a charter review every 10 years.
measures.yesMeans: The city charter is amended with these clarifying revisions and a required charter review every 10 years.
measures.noMeans: The charter keeps its current provisions and has no required 10-year review.
